# ankra_cluster_metrics_source (Data Source)

A cluster's metrics and log sources (`ankra cluster metrics source`): the backends Ankra reads the cluster's metrics and log history from, and the credential each resolves to, never its secret. Set them with the cluster's `spec.prometheus_metrics` and `spec.log_source` and an `ankra_datasource_credential`. Reading needs `clusters.read` on the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cluster_metrics_source" "prod" {
  cluster_id = "0b6f1d2e-1111-4222-8333-944445555666"
}

output "metrics_backend" {
  value = data.ankra_cluster_metrics_source.prod.metrics.endpoint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Identifier of the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The cluster id.
- `logs` (Attributes) The log source; null when the cluster has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logs))
- `metrics` (Attributes) The metrics source; null when the cluster has none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics))

<a id="nestedatt--logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logs`

Read-Only:

- `credential_name` (String) Name of the credential the source resolves to.
- `endpoint` (String) Address of the backend, without any user or password.
- `index_pattern` (String) Index pattern logs are read from.
- `provider_name` (String) Log backend, such as `loki` or `opensearch`.
- `state` (String) State of the source.
- `verify_ssl` (Boolean) Whether the backend's TLS certificate is verified.

<a id="nestedatt--metrics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics`

Read-Only:

- `credential_name` (String) Name of the credential the source resolves to.
- `endpoint` (String) Address of the backend, without any user or password.
- `flavor` (String) Backend flavour, such as `mimir` or `thanos`.
- `provider_name` (String) Metrics backend, such as `prometheus`.
- `state` (String) State of the source.
